verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, so an official MCP server that lets external agents reach its mailbox is a fair question, and the axis applies. The evidence only shows Shortwave acting as an MCP client: its own AI Assistant can connect to third-party or custom MCP servers. Nothing shows Shortwave publishing an MCP server that outside agents can connect to, so the client-side capability earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
